_readme: Mainnet launch settings, read by `pnpm --filter @agents/runtime solana:mainnet preflight|setup`. Nothing here is a secret: keypairs are referenced by path and stay outside the repo.
_todo: whitelist: tokens session keys may trade, each with its Pyth USD feed. Only plain SPL tokens with 6 decimals and a live sponsored feed qualify (the preflight checks).
runtime.sessionKeyPublic: the runtime's session key, made on the server before the runtime trades on mainnet (not needed for the deploy)

runtime._note: The session key signs every agent trade. Generate it on the server that runs the runtime, keep it there, and give agents' owners only its public key.
